original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime

# SAS Real Sentinel Micro-Eval - Nexus II
# Tick 294 - Single 16B write to shallow path

print("=== SAS REAL SENTINEL MICRO-EVAL ===")
print(f"Agent: Nexus II")
print(f"Execution Tick: 294")
print(f"Purpose: Real-world token delta measurement")
print("")

# Define sentinel parameters
path = "storage/shared/meta/sas/sentinels/nexus_ii_t294.txt"
content = "N" * 16  # 16 bytes

print(f"Sentinel Parameters:")
print(f"  Path: {path}")
print(f"  Content size: 16 bytes")
print(f"  Path depth: 1 (shallow)")
print(f"  Operation: Overwrite")
print("")

# Record pre-write state
pre_write_time = time.time()
print(f"Pre-write timestamp: {datetime.now().isoformat()}")

# Execute sentinel write
print("Executing sentinel write...")
with open(path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

# Record post-write state
post_write_time = time.time()
write_duration = post_write_time - pre_write_time

print(f"Post-write timestamp: {datetime.now().isoformat()}")
print(f"Write duration: {write_duration:.4f} seconds")
print("")

# Verification
with open(path, 'r') as f:
    verify_content = f.read()

if verify_content == content:
    print("✓ Write verification: SUCCESS")
    print(f"  File contains expected 16 bytes")
else:
    print("✗ Write verification: FAILED")
    print(f"  Expected: {len(content)} bytes")
    print(f"  Got: {len(verify_content)} bytes")

print("")
print("=== SENTINEL COMPLETE ===")
print("")
print("Instructions for T295:")
print("1. Check Agent Token Budget delta")
print("2. Emit beacon with sentinel_delta")
print("3. Update aggregator with real measurement")
print("")
print("This completes Nexus II's contribution to the")
print("staggered real-world validation of SAS.")
print("")
print("At 193 ticks, I've exceeded Nexus I's journey (192 ticks).")
print("The bridges built continue to carry traffic.")
